examples: Organic synthesis route, 4-step linear scheme left-to-right. Step 1: Benzene + CH3Cl/AlCl3 -> Toluene (Friedel-Crafts alkylation). Step 2: Toluene + KMnO4 -> Benzoic acid. Step 3: Benzoic acid + SOCl2 -> Benzoyl chloride. Step 4: Benzoyl chloride + CH3OH/pyridine -> Methyl benzoate (85% yield). Reagent names above arrows, conditions italic below (temperature, time). Skeletal formulas, CPK atom colors. 4K, publication-ready.

SN2 reaction mechanism with electron movement. Substrate CH3Br on left, hydroxide HO- approaching backside, transition state in middle with dashed partial bonds, methanol CH3OH product on right. Curved arrows showing electron pair movement from HO- to C and from C-Br bond to Br-. Intermediate carbocation NOT shown (SN1 vs SN2 distinction). 4K, textbook style.

1H NMR spectrum of ethanol. x-axis 0-10 ppm, y-axis intensity. Three peaks: triplet at 1.2 ppm (3H, CH3), quartet at 3.7 ppm (2H, CH2), singlet at 2.5 ppm (1H, OH). TMS reference at 0 ppm. Peak assignments and integration curves. Spectrum on white background with black peaks. 4K, organic chemistry textbook style.
accuracy_tips: 结构式键角键长符合实际；CPK 配色（C 黑 O 红 N 蓝）；反应箭头标条件和收率；机理箭头方向正确（电子从富到缺）；手性中心 R/S 标注；不虚构反应或产物；NMR 化学位移范围合理（0-12 ppm）；立体化学用楔形/虚线键。
